And since it is Monday today as the perfect day to do so. So in order to be able to withdraw your money, go to your dashboard and go to transfer funds alright and scroll down at the bottom this is where you will see withdraw money from your wallet this area is not visible if it's not a Monday so we're able to see today that's why I wanted to make this video now you see just read this qualifications here I think the most important information you need to know is that minimum withdrawal should be $40 and you had to have a full name and address on file. So in order for you to confirm your identification and address you had to upload some kind of document. What you can upload is just something like passport or driver's license or anything like that that shows your full name and your photo and also your date of birth and your address. And this document should also have a document number. I think that's a driver's license number or a passport number and the document should be in English otherwise you have to provide a certified translation for the document. And documents must be in standard full-size pages scanned image should be in color high-resolution and at least 150 dpi and format should be jpeg or PDF scroll down here you'll see some more requirements so here's what says your ID should have a full name and your address and address should be recent not older than three months same thing down here so once you provided all that you can go in proceed but your name here you can put your username for solid trust or email address for payza and for iPad you can put your username there. And Account which one of these you want your money to go to. You should have already established an account with any of these guys in the beginning when you first signed up. And identity card number. So it says here official government issued document number. So I am thinking that if it is this address license he should put your drivers license number or passport your passport number here and just uh... go down to you even more swedish agreements click this check mark right here input withdrawal and that should be at you should be able to do this every monday
